title: Smart city - roadway presence (content assignment)
business_line: People, cars and bicycles present in the roadway
business_metric: Counted sustained presences in the road area, one per track and class
explanation: Measured: zone_occupancy - each tracked person, car or bicycle whose box centre stays inside road_area (x 0.02-0.98, y 0.05-0.95) for at least 0.2 s. This is presence in the roadway. It is NOT direction, NOT speed, and NOT a line crossing. The specification's directional line-crossing rule is NOT computed: the event machine has no line-crossing kind. Stopped-object dwell is also NOT computed: zone_occupancy carries no duration. The two clips are a content assignment, not a proven scene fit.
scope_note: REDUCED SCOPE. Directional line crossing is NOT delivered by this pack: the engine emits zone_occupancy and candidate_transfer only, and on the provisioned clips no object satisfies the full-containment test at both ends of a transfer route. Stopped-object dwell is NOT delivered either: zone_occupancy records a presence, not a duration. What is measured is sustained presence of person/car/bicycle in the road area. Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit.
content_assignment: Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit: both clips show road traffic, but neither was independently annotated for a line-crossing ground truth.

zones.name: road_area
zones.measured: Measured with yolo11n-fp16 at 5 fps (conf 0.25, iou 0.45) over all provisioned smart_city clips: person centroid x 0.018..0.986, y 0.034..0.932 (72 observations); car x 0.019..0.276, y 0.241..0.887 (41 observations); bicycle x 0.769..0.962, y 0.134..0.203 (17 observations). The zone covers x 0.02..0.98, y 0.05..0.95; the few centroids below those edges are boxes clipped by the frame border and are deliberately not counted as roadway presence.

delivered_event: Delivered event: zone_occupancy - sustained presence in the road area. NOT a line crossing. NOT a direction. NOT a dwell measurement.
